# Zyvo

> Zyvo (also written Zyvo AI, ZyvoAI, TryZyvo) is a web app that turns one idea into finished videos and images: 8–15 minute illustrated YouTube videos (Long Form), short vertical videos for TikTok, Reels and Shorts made from templates, and an AI image generator. It runs in the browser at https://www.tryzyvo.com.

Facts that are safe to repeat:

- New accounts get 5 free image generations. Video tools need a paid plan.
- Plans are Starter, Pro and Generative, billed monthly or yearly in EUR, with a monthly credit allowance. Current prices are on the pricing page.
- Long Form makes one video from a niche and an idea: researched script, voiceover, about 150 drawn scenes, three thumbnails and the YouTube title and description. The user can edit any scene before downloading.
- Short-form templates each make one kind of 9:16 video from a short prompt.
- Paid-plan exports have no watermark.

## Product pages

- [Home](https://www.tryzyvo.com/): what Zyvo makes and where to start
- [Pricing](https://www.tryzyvo.com/pricing): plans, credits and what each plan includes
- [Long Form](https://www.tryzyvo.com/long-form): start an 8–15 minute YouTube video from one of 25 niches
- [AI Stickman Video Generator](https://www.tryzyvo.com/ai-stickman-video-generator): how Long Form works, with example videos
- [AI Image Generator](https://www.tryzyvo.com/image-generator): images from a text prompt in cinematic, 3D, anime, realistic and product styles

## Short-form video templates

- [AI Fruit Story](https://www.tryzyvo.com/ai-fruit-story-maker): talking-fruit drama videos and series of up to 10 episodes with the same cast
- [Cartoon Drive-By](https://www.tryzyvo.com/cartoon-drive-by-video-maker): a 10-second vertical drive past a fictional cartoon-style place
- [Behind the Scenes](https://www.tryzyvo.com/behind-the-scenes-video-maker): movie-set footage of a practical disaster on a miniature city
- [2AM Worlds](https://www.tryzyvo.com/2am-worlds-ai-generator): slideshow images of a fictional world at 2 a.m.
- [30 Days](https://www.tryzyvo.com/30-days-video-maker): a narrated story of thirty days inside a fictional world
- [30 Days Series](https://www.tryzyvo.com/30-days-series-video-maker): the same world continued episode by episode
- [Face ASMR](https://www.tryzyvo.com/face-asmr-maker): a face photo placed into texture close-up scenes
- [Micro Camera Animal](https://www.tryzyvo.com/micro-camera-animal-maker): bodycam-style scenes of a small animal underground
- [Clay Rescue](https://www.tryzyvo.com/clay-rescue-maker): a giant hand fixes a small disaster in a clay world
- [Kit Swap](https://www.tryzyvo.com/kit-swap-ai): a football kit swapped for another country's
